pages.title: Build two columns
pages.text: Place a $(item)Negarite Generator$() and a $(item)Posirite Generator$(). Put at least one matching tank directly above each one.$(br2)Feed Negarite Dust to the Negarite Generator and Posirite Dust to the Posirite Generator. Use the hologram arrows to transfer fuel, or supply it with item automation.

pages.title: Increase your output
pages.text: Each consecutive matching tank adds $(thing)1,000 flux per tick$() of that generator’s type. Stack tanks upward without gaps.$(br2)A dust item normally lasts about 30 seconds while enabled. Fuel burns even when output is unused, so switch idle generators off with their redstone mode.$(br2)Keep the two columns balanced before adding more consumers.
